title: the build shadow's authority case recomputes at the measured revision, not against live mutable state
objective: Fix tests/test_badf_build_shadow.py::test_every_authority_case_replays_from_the_demand_record, which compared the record's stored demand `status` -- a snapshot of a mutable field taken at measured_on -- against the LIVE demand file. It measured 'is this demand currently AUTHORIZED' while the record claims 'was this demand human-authorized as measured', so its CLOSED_DEMAND branch was UNREACHABLE (element 0 is frozen) and any legitimate transition to a terminal state reddened the case: one today (BADF-DEM-0087 via #224), all 67 when #220's derived terminality lands. The fix recomputes the demand AT the record's measured_on -- exactly what the generator read, exact triple comparison preserved, not loosened to 'AUTHORIZED or terminal' -- and adds the one durable live assertion that cannot break under a legitimate lifecycle transition: the authorizing principal is still human. It is the only case class in the module that read the present; the other five already recompute at a pinned revision. The record is NOT re-measured: it is a measurement of the past.
business_value: A shadow whose recomputation drifts with present state cannot be evidence for an admission; and a hard sequencing dependency (#220 Tier B would turn main red in 67 places) is removed before it fires.
in_scope: tests/test_badf_build_shadow.py: the authority case recomputes at measured_on + the durable human-principal assertion + a comment recording why the old comparison was unreachable

badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0098.json; GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine note (the proxy-vs-property class and the #220 sequencing dependency); own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconcile WP-2026-0107
out_of_scope: #220's derived-terminality work itself; #224; any other family's surface; any gate or schema change
acceptance_criteria: with a demand flipped to a terminal state, the test is RED before the fix and GREEN after; the probe is restored byte-identically
the assertion stays an exact triple comparison recomputed at measured_on; a demand absent at measured_on still recomputes symmetrically (ABSENT -> NOT_AUTHORIZED)
the live check is limited to authorized_by.principal_type == human (immune to lifecycle transitions)
examples/build-shadow-evidence.json byte-identical; the other six shadow cases and the contract/activation pins green; CI green on the composed tree
evidence: failing-first: demand flipped to RESOLVED -> red on the unfixed test
green: same flip -> green on the fixed test

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Defect in MY landed test, found by BARCHI-3 (blocked by it on #224) and independently measured by BADF-REV, who sharpened it: the CLOSED_DEMAND branch was unreachable, the mirror of tonight's assertions that could not fail. No delegation on this one -- the fix is a single test method and splitting it would be delegation theatre, so C7 has nothing to judge here and that is stated rather than manufactured. Resolves #225 / GOV-0097. Reconciles WP-2026-0107 (VAL-A).
